text:
Barnaby the Dinosaur was known for his extensive vocabulary, but his idiosyncrasy was that he could never use a simple word when a complex one would do. When he tried to order a sandwich, he didn't ask for "bread"; he demanded "a leavened, baked staple food made of dough from flour and water." The baker, exhausted by the verbosity, simply handed him a cracker and said, "Here is your 'small, thin, crisp wafer of baked dough.' Now, please leave."

The main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.
